square_mm_note: Measured 2026-09-24 on the printed board with a ruler: 194.5 mm over 8 squares (24.31) and 121.0 mm over 5 (24.20), 315.5 mm over 13 = 24.27 mm. The solve ran with 24.0; the square size scales ONLY the translation, so translation_mm and baseline_mm were multiplied by 24.27/24.0 = 1.01125. Rotation, rms and the intrinsics in golf_sim_config.json do not depend on it.
frame: X right along the baseline, Y down, Z forward. Camera 1 is the left module facing the unit.
